title: Legacy Training Versus Browser Heuristic
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of train_predict.py/models.py and disconnected demo UI, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in loan-default-prediction.
learning_objectives: Explain train_predict.py/models.py and disconnected demo UI in plain language and connect it to index.html; js/app.js; WORKFLOW.md.
Trace one input through the legacy training versus browser heuristic stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
practical_outcomes: Trace the legacy training versus browser heuristic stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for train_predict.py/models.py and disconnected demo UI.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
